fileNodes.name: alchemy.run.ts
fileNodes.summary: Alchemy stack entry point that defines the "NewApp" Cloudflare deployment: it wires the R2 bucket and Worker resources together via an Effect generator and outputs the bucket name and Worker URL.

fileNodes.name: bucket.ts
fileNodes.summary: Declares the shared Cloudflare R2 bucket resource ("Bucket") consumed by both the stack definition and the Worker.

fileNodes.name: worker.ts
fileNodes.summary: Defines the Cloudflare Worker resource with an Effect-based fetch handler implementing a simple key-value HTTP API over the R2 bucket: PUT streams an upload to the bucket, GET reads an object back as text, with 404 and R2Error-to-500 handling.

fileNodes.name: CLAUDE.md
fileNodes.summary: AI-assistant project instructions mandating the Bun runtime over Node.js, with sections covering Bun-native APIs (Bun.serve, bun:sqlite, Bun.sql), testing via bun test, and frontend patterns using HTML imports instead of Vite.

fileNodes.name: README.md
fileNodes.summary: Minimal project readme generated by bun init, covering dependency installation with bun install and running the app via bun run index.ts.

fileNodes.name: biome.json
fileNodes.summary: Biome formatter and linter configuration enabling tab indentation, single quotes for JS/TS, recommended lint rules, git-aware file ignoring, and automatic import organization.

fileNodes.name: package.json
fileNodes.summary: Package manifest declaring index.ts as the module entry point, with runtime dependencies on alchemy, effect, and the Effect platform adapters for Bun and Node, plus Biome and Bun types as dev dependencies.

fileNodes.name: tsconfig.json
fileNodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration in bundler mode (Bun-oriented) with strict type checking, noEmit, verbatimModuleSyntax, and allowance for importing .ts extensions directly.

fileNodes.name: test.md
fileNodes.summary: Single-line placeholder markdown file used as sample content for testing uploads, likely to the project's Cloudflare bucket.

fileNodes.name: index.ts
fileNodes.summary: Default Bun entry point generated by bun init; currently just prints a hello message and contains no application logic.
